feedback: I sometimes miss failed payments because they are not prominent enough in the current view.
When several payments are processing, it is difficult to spot which one has failed without opening records individually.
A clearer failed status would help me deal with customer calls more quickly.
Failures can get buried among successful transactions, especially on busy days.
I would find it useful to have failed payments grouped somewhere obvious rather than searching for them.
I have not noticed payment failures being hard to find in my work.
Our team generally finds payment status clear.
